greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyingcwele. Makube noxolo nani nonke namhlanje nj1ba siba buthatha phambi kobuso bukaThixo.
penitential:

homily:
Apha emhlabeni, kukho izinto ezincinci ezihlala zibeka uphawu entliziyweni yomntu ngaphandle kokuba umntu athethe lukhulu. Zicingele nje izihlangu ezishiywe emnyango, okanye ipeni esele yomile phezu kwetafile yokufundela, indawo eyayihlala ihlekisa ngamabanga athile. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayehlala enezinto ezininzi ezisengqondweni, engumntwana owayesazi ukuba indlela yobomi ifuna ukuzimisela okukhulu. Khumbula indlela awayeyithanda ngayo indalo, indlela awayephila ngayo ngobuhle bokucinga ngezinto ezinkulu njengezindiza ezihamba esibhakabhakeni, ezifana nala mava amnandi ayewenza nobawo wakhe. Kodwa ngaphaya kwayo yonke inzululwazi, ngaphaya kobukrelekrele bakhe bokufunda izibalo eziphezulu esemncinci, uBen wayeneentliziyo eyayithambile, entle, eyazi ukuba kuthetha ukuthini ukuba ngumntwana ohloniphayo.

KwiNcwadi ka-Efese namhlanje, uPawulos usixelela into enzima kakhulu: 'Draw your strength from the Lord and from his mighty power. Put on the armor of God.' Uthetha ngeengubo zokuzikhusela, ngekhaka, nekrele elingcwele. Masiyimele kancinci le mfanekiso… Umpostile akathethi ngeenkrwada zenyama, kodwa uthetha ngemfazwe ephakathi kokukhanya nobumnyama. Uthi kufuneka sibe nezixhobo zikaThixo ukuze sikwazi ukuma ngenxa yobubi beli hlabathi. UBen wayeyazi le mfazwe ngendlela yakhe. Wayengumfana owalwayo, umfana owazama ngayo yonke intliziyo yakhe xa wayephumelela kwimidlalo yakhe, engoyiki ukuzama nokuba kwakunzima kangakanani.

KwiVangeli, sibona uYesu esithi kuHerode, ‘fox’—‘lo mchum.’ UYesu akoyiki amandla alesi hlabathi. Uqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe, ehamba namhlanje nangomso, kuba akunakwenzeka ukuba umprofeti afe ngaphandle kweJerusalem. UYesu ubonisa ukuba ubomi bakhe busezandleni zikaThixo, hayi ezandleni zabaqhathi. Kwaye uyaqhubeka athethe ngentsholo enqabileyo: 'Jerusalem, Jerusalem... how many times I yearned to gather your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, but you were unwilling!' Ufanisa uThixo nomama wenkukhu okhuselayo, olula amaphiko akhe ukufihla abantwana bakhe. UThixo akanguye umlawuli okude; unguYise onothando olunzulu, olula amaphiko akhe ukusikhusela ngamaxesha okuba nzima.

Kodwa masiyimele le nyaniso kwaye siyibone ngendlela ebonakala ngayo emindenini yethu. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela ebuhlungu kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kukaBen kusebenza isikhewu esikhulu endlwini yenu. Mamele kakuhle namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola, bebuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na abanokukwenza ngcono. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, engumntu oqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando lwakho lwemihla ngemihla. Xa ucinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngeziganeko ezimnandi enazibonayo, yazi ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Ukuze uBenjamin Vo kunye nabo bonke abasebenzi bakaThixo abahamba phambili baphumle ngokuxolelaniswa nokukhanya kwakhe okungapheliyo.
Ukuze bonke abantu abasezintlungwini nasekubandezelekeni bafumane intuthuzelo nethemba elivela kuThixo uSomandla.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, zomelezeni eNkosini nakwamandla ayo amakhulu. Fowunini iingubo zokuzikhusela zikaThixo ukuze nibe nako ukuma niqinile nxamnye namaqhinga kaDiveli. Ngokuba umzabalazo wethu akusiyo owenyama negazi, ngowabaphathi, namandla, namagosa obumnyama bale mihla, nemimoya emibi yasezulwini. Ngenxa yoko, thathani iingubo zokuzikhusela zikaThixo, ukuze nibe nako ukuxhathisa ngamini mbi, nide nithi nikwenzile konke, nime niqinile. Ngoko simani niqinile, amabhanti enyu esilungisiwe ngenxa yenyaniso, nifake isifuba sokulunga njengesikrweqe, iinyawo zenu zihlotshiswe ngokulungela iVangeli yoxolo. Kuzo zonke izinto, thabathani ukholo lube ikhaka, eniya kucima ngalo onke imicibisholo evuthayo yomubi. Thabathani nesigungu sosindiso, nekreleni loMoya, elililizwi likaThixo. Ngayo yonke imithandazo nokubongoza, thandazani ngamaxesha onke ngethuba loMoya. Ngenxa yoko, phaphani ngokucocekileyo nangokubongoza ngabo bonke abangcwele, nam ngenxa yam, ukuze ndinikelwe ilizwi lokuvula umlomo wam, ukuba ndazise ngesibindi imfihlelo yeVangeli, endiyisithunywa sayo emakhoneni, ukuze ndibe nesibindi sokuthetha njengoko kufanele ndithethe ngakho.

readings.label: INdumiso yokuphendula
readings.text:
R. Makabongwe uThixo, iThwala lam!
Makabongwe uThixo, iThwala lam, oqeqesha izandla zam emfazwini, iminwe yam kulwabi.
R. Makabongwe uThixo, iThwala lam!
Inceba yam nenqaba yam, inqaba yam ephezulu nomhlanguli wam, ikhaka lam endithemba kulo, ohlawulisa abantu bam phantsi kwam.
R. Makabongwe uThixo, iThwala lam!
Thixo, ndiya kucula ingoma entsha kuwe; ngethumbu elishumi ndiya kukuculela indumiso, wena onika ookumkani uloyiso, ohlangula uDavide umkhonzi wakhe krele elibi.
R. Makabongwe uThixo, iThwala lam!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngelo xesha abanye abaFarisi beza kuYesu bathi kuye, 'Phuma uhambe apha, ngokuba uHerode uthanda ukukubulala.' Wathi kubo, 'Hambani niy告诉 lo mchum, “Yabona, ndikhuphela imimoya emibi ngaphandle, ndenze nokuphilisa namhlanje nangomso, kanti ngomhla wesithathu ndiya kugqiba umsebenzi wam.” Noko ke kumelwe ukuba ndihambe namhlanje nangomso nangosuku olulandelayo, ngokuba akunakwenzeka ukuba umprofeti afe ngaphandle kweJerusalem. Jerusalem, Jerusalem, wena obulala abaprofeti, ugibisela ngamatye abo bathunyelwe kuwe, zingaphi na izihlandlo bendinqwenela ukuhlanganisa abantwana bakho njengenkukhu ehlanganisa amantshontsho ayo phantsi kwamaphiko ayo, kanti anivanga! Yabona, indlu yenu ishiyiwe yaba yintlango. Ndithi ke kuni, aniyi kundibona kude kube sezinzulwini zexesha apho niya kuthi khona, “Makabongwe ozayo egameni leNkosi.”'

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam Yeses Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramento Elingcwele LaseAltar. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwezinto zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramento, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ufikile, kwaye ndiyazihlanganisa kuwe ngokuphelele; musa ukuvumela ukuba ndize ndahlulwe nawe naphezulu. Amen.
closing: UThixo uSomandla akugcine, akukhanyisele ngobuso bakhe, kwaye akuphathise uxolo lwakhe lwangunaphakade. Amen.

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
